SELECT 
	ReportGroup=1,
	PayrollCode=EP.PayrollCode,
	Date=EP.Date,
	PaymentDate=EP.PaymentDate,
	Posted=EP.Posted,
	PostDate=EP.PostDate,
	UserCode=EP.UserCode,
	LastSaved=EP.LastSaved,
	FromDate=EP.FromDate,
	ToDate=EP.ToDate,
	EmpID = (SELECT E.EmpID FROM EMP_Employee E WHERE E.EMPCode = EP.EmpCode),
	EmpCode=EP.EmpCode,
	Category = (SELECT EC.Name FROM EMP_Category EC, EMP_Employee E WHERE EP.EmpCode = E.EmpCode AND E.EmpCatCode = EC.EmpCatCode),
	Department = (SELECT ED.Name FROM EMP_Department ED, EMP_Employee E WHERE EP.EmpCode = E.EmpCode AND E.DeptCode = ED.DeptCode),
	Designation = (SELECT ED.Name FROM EMP_Designation ED, EMP_Employee E WHERE EP.EmpCode = E.EmpCode AND E.DesigCode = ED.DesigCode),
	PayType=(SELECT P.PayType FROM EMP_Pay P WHERE P.EMPCode = EP.EmpCode),
	WorkDays=EP.WorkDays,
	Presents=EP.Presents,
	Absents=EP.Absents,
	Leaves=EP.Leaves,
	sundays=EP.sundays,
	holidays=EP.holidays,
	WorkingHours=(SELECT P.Workinghours FROM EMP_Pay P WHERE P.EMPCode = EP.EmpCode),
	HoursWorked=EP.HoursWorked,
	PerHourRate=EP.PerHourRate,
	StandardBasicPay = (SELECT EPP.BasicPay FROM EMP_Pay EPP WHERE EPP.EmpCode = EP.EmpCode),
	BasicPay=EP.BasicPay,
	OverTimeHours=EP.OverTimeHours,
	OverTimeRate=EP.OverTimeRate,
	OverTime=EP.OverTime,
	BonusPay=EP.BonusPay,
	SpecialPay=EP.SpecialPay,
	AdditionalPay=EP.AdditionalPay, 
	OtherPay=EP.OtherPay,
	Fine=EP.Fine,
	Penalty=EP.Penalty,
	OtherCharge=EP.OtherCharge,
	Advance=EP.Advance,
	NetPayable=EP.NetPayable,
	Detail=SPACE(1000),
	Amount = 0.00,
	Paid = EP.Paid,
	PaidVia=EP.PaidVia,
	PaidBy = EP.PaidBy,
	PaymentrefNo = EP.PaymentrefNo,
	PaymentRemarks=EP.PaymentRemarks
FROM EMP_Payroll EP
WHERE EP.PayrollCode=:ai_code
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	ReportGroup=1,
	PayrollCode=EP.PayrollCode,
	Date=EP.Date,
	PaymentDate=EP.PaymentDate,
	Posted=EP.Posted,
	PostDate=EP.PostDate,
	UserCode=EP.UserCode,

	EmpID = (SELECT E.EmpID FROM EMP_Employee E WHERE E.EMPCode = EP.EmpCode),
	EmpCode=EP.EmpCode,
	Category = (SELECT EC.Name FROM EMP_Category EC, EMP_Employee E WHERE EP.EmpCode = E.EmpCode AND E.EmpCatCode = EC.EmpCatCode),
	Department = (SELECT ED.Name FROM EMP_Department ED, EMP_Employee E WHERE EP.EmpCode = E.EmpCode AND E.DeptCode = ED.DeptCode),
	Designation = (SELECT ED.Name FROM EMP_Designation ED, EMP_Employee E WHERE EP.EmpCode = E.EmpCode AND E.DesigCode = ED.DesigCode),
	PayType=(SELECT P.PayType FROM EMP_Pay P WHERE P.EMPCode = EP.EmpCode),
	WorkDays=EP.WorkDays,
	Presents=EP.Presents,
	Absents=EP.Absents,
	Leaves=EP.Leaves,
	sundays=EP.sundays,
	holidays=EP.holidays,
	WorkingHours=(SELECT P.Workinghours FROM EMP_Pay P WHERE P.EMPCode = EP.EmpCode),
	HoursWorked=EP.HoursWorked,
	PerHourRate=EP.PerHourRate,
	StandardBasicPay = (SELECT EPP.BasicPay FROM EMP_Pay EPP WHERE EPP.EmpCode = EP.EmpCode),
	BasicPay=EP.BasicPay,
	OverTimeHours=EP.OverTimeHours,
	OverTimeRate=EP.OverTimeRate,
	OverTime=EP.OverTime,
	BonusPay=EP.BonusPay,
	SpecialPay=EP.SpecialPay,
	AdditionalPay=EP.AdditionalPay, 
	OtherPay=EP.OtherPay,
	Fine=EP.Fine,
	Penalty=EP.Penalty,
	OtherCharge=EP.OtherCharge,
	Advance=EP.Advance,
	NetPayable=EP.NetPayable,
	Detail=EA.Name,
	Amount = Round((EP.BasicPay * EPA.Percentage * 0.01) + EPA.FlatAmount, 2),
	Paid = EP.Paid,
	PaidVia=EP.PaidVia,
	PaidBy = EP.PaidBy,
	PaymentrefNo = EP.PaymentrefNo,
	PaymentRemarks=EP.PaymentRemarks
FROM EMP_Payroll EP, Emp_PayrollAllowances EPA, EMP_Allowance EA
WHERE EP.PayrollCode=:ai_code AND EP.PayrollCode = EPA.PayrollCode AND EPA.AllowanceCode = EA.AllowanceCode AND
	( EPA.Percentage > 0 OR EPA.FlatAmount > 0 )
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	ReportGroup=2,
	PayrollCode=EP.PayrollCode,
	Date=EP.Date,
	PaymentDate=EP.PaymentDate,
	Posted=EP.Posted,
	PostDate=EP.PostDate,
	UserCode=EP.UserCode,
	LastSaved=EP.LastSaved,
	FromDate=EP.FromDate,
	ToDate=EP.ToDate,
	EmpID = (SELECT E.EmpID FROM EMP_Employee E WHERE E.EMPCode = EP.EmpCode),
	EmpCode=EP.EmpCode,
	Category = (SELECT EC.Name FROM EMP_Category EC, EMP_Employee E WHERE EP.EmpCode = E.EmpCode AND E.EmpCatCode = EC.EmpCatCode),
	Department = (SELECT ED.Name FROM EMP_Department ED, EMP_Employee E WHERE EP.EmpCode = E.EmpCode AND E.DeptCode = ED.DeptCode),
	Designation = (SELECT ED.Name FROM EMP_Designation ED, EMP_Employee E WHERE EP.EmpCode = E.EmpCode AND E.DesigCode = ED.DesigCode),
	PayType=(SELECT P.PayType FROM EMP_Pay P WHERE P.EMPCode = EP.EmpCode),
	WorkDays=EP.WorkDays,
	Presents=EP.Presents,
	Absents=EP.Absents,
	Leaves=EP.Leaves,
	sundays=EP.sundays,
	holidays=EP.holidays,
	WorkingHours=(SELECT P.Workinghours FROM EMP_Pay P WHERE P.EMPCode = EP.EmpCode),
	HoursWorked=EP.HoursWorked,
	PerHourRate=EP.PerHourRate,
	StandardBasicPay = (SELECT EPP.BasicPay FROM EMP_Pay EPP WHERE EPP.EmpCode = EP.EmpCode),
	BasicPay=EP.BasicPay,
	OverTimeHours=EP.OverTimeHours,
	OverTimeRate=EP.OverTimeRate,
	OverTime=EP.OverTime,
	BonusPay=EP.BonusPay,
	SpecialPay=EP.SpecialPay,
	AdditionalPay=EP.AdditionalPay, 
	OtherPay=EP.OtherPay,
	Fine=EP.Fine,
	Penalty=EP.Penalty,
	OtherCharge=EP.OtherCharge,
	Advance=EP.Advance,
	NetPayable=EP.NetPayable,
	Detail=A.Name,
	Amount = - Round((EP.BasicPay * EPD.Percentage * 0.01) + EPD.FlatAmount, 2),
	Paid = EP.Paid,
	PaidVia=EP.PaidVia,
	PaidBy = EP.PaidBy,
	PaymentrefNo = EP.PaymentrefNo,
	PaymentRemarks=EP.PaymentRemarks
FROM EMP_Payroll EP, Emp_PayrollDeductions EPD, EMP_Deduction ED, Accounts A
WHERE EP.PayrollCode=:ai_code AND 
	EP.PayrollCode = EPD.PayrollCode AND 
	EPD.DeductionCode = ED.DeductionCode AND 
	ED.DeductionCode = A.AccCode AND
	( EPD.Percentage > 0 OR EPD.FlatAmount > 0 )
